message.Title: Generally Available: AKS support for Kubernetes version 1.34

Body.Content:
Kubernetes version 1.34 is now generally available for AKS. This release introduces 58 upstream enhancements, including 23 Stable features, 22 Beta features, and 13 Alpha features.


These enhancements help technical practitioners improve cluster operations, incorporate new functionality, and plan upgrades with greater confidence. 

Learn more.
